provenance:
Cold review of the ADR-033 resolver, 2026-08-24 (finding 1 of 3), promoted per CLAUDE.md hard rule 2. bac-2006 typesets its cover as an ALTERNATING CAPTION/VALUE STACK -- caption on its own line ending in a colon, value on the next line: 'Commission file number:

1-6523

Exact name of registrant as specified in its charter:

Bank of America Corporation

State or other jurisdiction of incorporation or organization:

Delaware

IRS Employer Identification No.:

56-0906609'. This is a THIRD name-caption orientation that ADR-033 §b3's table did not have: not value-before-caption, and not caption-and-value-sharing-a-line (which is what §b3 recorded for this very fixture, from a synthetic miniature in cover.py::_demo that does not reproduce the committed bytes). MEASURED RED at the first resolver: registrant_name resolved to 'Delaware' via `positional` at 0.95 (the caption is on its own line, so `own_line` was true, orientation A took the line above the caption, and the fallback then read the wrong line), and state_of_incorporation resolved to 'IRS Employer Identification No.:' via `ein_pivot` at 0.95 -- the EIN opens its line, so the walk-back landed on a CAPTION and published it as the state. Both were verbatim at their own offsets, so `_cover_shape` and the `cover` check's re-derivation both passed: the wrongness was invisible to every check that existed. This case is why the golden four were not a corpus.
